snippet.title: NINJA GAIDEN 4 - Advanced Yakumo Gameplay | Gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Yakumo infiltrates the headquarters of the Divine Dragon Order in this stunning demonstration of NINJA GAIDEN 4's high-octane combat. 

Pre-order now to receive the Dark Dragon Descendant skin seen in this video! 
NINJA GAIDEN 4 launches October 21 on Xbox, Steam, and PlayStation.
#NINJAGAIDEN #NINJAGAIDEN4 #TeamNINJAStudio
